name: Taipei Zoo
tagline: Giant panda, koala, red panda first — Malayan tiger stays off the Sumatran card.

practical.ticket_note: MRT to zoo; crowds at pandas.
practical.best_start: Pandas if open, else one loop.

items.label: Giant panda
items.one_liner: 大貓熊 — bamboo busy or a full rest?

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Giant panda?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Koala
items.one_liner: 無尾熊 — sleepy eucalyptus eater. Look twice.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Koala?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.one_liner: 小貓熊 / Red Panda — rusty and tree-high.

qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!
